### Device Overview
- **Brand / Label:** (e.g. Secureye, eSSL, Realand, BioMax)
- **Model Number:** (e.g. S-FB3K, X2008, SpeedFace-V5L)
- **System Info Firmware String:** (e.g. `M61BH v3.16`, `ZAM180_TFT`)
- **Algorithm Strings:** (e.g. `EbknFace V3.0`, `ZKFinger VX10.0`)

### Network Scan Results
- **Open Ports:** (e.g. 80, 4370, 5005, 3718)
- **Observed Protocol:** (LogClient / FkWeb / WebSocket / ADMS / pyzk)

### Verification
- [ ] Attendance pull/push verified
- [ ] Door unlock tested
- [ ] Standalone Linux listener verified

### Additional Notes / Quirks
(Include any specific menu configuration steps or gotchas)
